practice_phrases.known: They didn't hope to leave so early.
practice_phrases.target: 他们不希望这么早离开。

practice_phrases.known: She didn't hope to miss the meeting.
We didn't hope to spend so much money on this.
practice_phrases.target: 我们不希望在这上面花这么多钱。

practice_phrases.known: He didn't hope to make such a big mistake.
practice_phrases.target: 他不希望犯这么大的错误。

practice_phrases.known: I didn't hope to hear such bad news from you today.
practice_phrases.target: 我不希望今天从你那里听到这样的坏消息。

practice_phrases.known: They didn't hope to find themselves in such a difficult situation.
practice_phrases.target: 他们不希望发现自己处于这么困难的情况。

practice_phrases.known: We didn't hope to have to cancel our vacation plans because of the weather.
practice_phrases.target: 我们不希望因为天气不得不取消我们的假期计划。

practice_phrases.known: She didn't hope to be working late every night when she accepted the new job.
practice_phrases.target: 她接受新工作的时候不希望每天晚上都要工作到很晚。
